name: refresh
description: Reload project context after compaction or at the start of a session
instructions:
Refresh project context. Read, do not guess; summarise at the end.

1. Read CLAUDE.md (project guide, conventions, architecture in one screen).
2. Run `git status`, `git branch --show-current`, `git log --oneline -10`; note uncommitted changes and check `git status PathOfBuilding/` is clean.
3. Read docs/BACKLOG.md (open work, known issues) and list docs/plans/ (active plans; read any with Status: active).
4. Skim README.md "## Changelog" top entry to know the current version.
5. If the task touches the evaluation path (src/pob/evaluator_batch.lua, worker_pool.py, incremental_calculator.py, optimizer candidate generation), read docs/PERFORMANCE.md so you know the baseline numbers and how to reproduce them.
6. Run the fast tests: `venv/bin/pytest tests/test_constraints.py tests/test_incremental_optimizer.py -q -k "not EndToEnd and not IncrementalCalculator"` (no PoB needed). Run the full suite only if asked.
7. Summarise:

   # Project Context Refreshed
   **Version / branch**: ...
   **Working tree**: clean | N modified files (list)
   **Active plans**: ...
   **Top backlog items**: 3-5 bullets
   **Test status**: ...
   **Suggested next step**: based on the above

Keep it short and concrete. Ask what to work on if the user has not said.
